dashboard.label: TA-sanpath Overview
dashboard.description: Collects storage-path health from device-mapper-multipath (systool -C) and iSCSI sessions (iscsiadm): per-multipath active/failed path counts and path state, plus iSCSI session

search.query: index=main sourcetype="sanpath:status" | stats latest(_time) as "Last seen", count as Reports by host | table host "Last seen" Reports
| mcatalog values(metric_name) as m where index=metrics metric_name="sanpath.*" | eval count=mvcount(m)
index=main sourcetype="sanpath:status" _raw="*alarm*" | sort - _time | table _time host _raw | rename _raw as Event | head 200
